description: Let LLMs and AI agents "watch" video. Zakira.Replay turns any video source — YouTube URLs, conference recordings, course lectures, local files — into speaker-attributed transcripts (captions or local Whisper STT), frame-level OCR and structured vision (local or LLM-routed), slide-aware grouping, and timestamped JSON evidence that agents can reason over. Ships as both a CLI (`zakira-replay`) and an MCP server (`zakira-replay mcp serve`) in one .NET 10 binary.
releaseNotes: 0.15.0 — MCP self-provisioning + slimmer package. New MCP tools let an agent set itself up without shelling out to the CLI: `deps-install` (downloads yt-dlp/ffmpeg/copilot-cli and local ONNX/OCR/vision/whisper/diarization models on demand) and `info` (resolved config + capability summary); the `doctor` MCP tool now returns the full report (binaries + local models + Ollama + Edge profile), matching the CLI. The info/doctor probe logic moved to a shared Core `DiagnosticsService`. Packaging: the redundant bundled RapidOCR `models/v5` set (~12 MB, never loaded — OCR models are downloaded on demand) is stripped from the package. Builds on 0.14.2 (colorized `doctor` output; on-demand Copilot CLI download instead of bundling the ~52 MB native binary). See CHANGELOG.md.
